user.title: Connect Braun BLE Device
user.description: Select a discovered Braun health device or enter connection details.

manual_address.title: Enter MAC Address
manual_address.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of the device (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

pairing_prompt.title: Put Device in Pairing Mode
pairing_prompt.description:
1. Ensure the device is powered **OFF**.
2. Press and **HOLD** the Power button for ~5 seconds until the screen turns **BLUE** with the Bluetooth icon and **'bt'** flashing.
3. Once the blue pairing screen is active, click **Submit** below.

*(The thermometer will generate a 6-digit PIN on its display)*.

enter_pin.title: Enter Pairing PIN
enter_pin.description: Enter the 6-digit code currently shown on the thermometer screen:

manual_keys.title: Manual Key Configuration
manual_keys.description: Enter pre-extracted authentication and encryption keys:

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device. Ensure it is turned on in pairing mode ('bt' flashing on blue screen).
error.pairing_timeout: Timed out waiting for the device to send recovery handshake.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be exactly 6 numeric digits.
error.pin_decrypt_failed: Failed to decrypt device keys. Check the 6 digits and retry.
error.invalid_key_length: Keys must be 32 hexadecimal characters (16 bytes).

abort.already_configured: This Braun device is already configured.

user.title: Add a person
user.description: Measurements from this device can then be attributed to this person.
